description: Phase 37 golden retrieval dataset (TITAN-BRN-011): 72 records (24 episodic / 24 semantic / 24 procedural; 48 org / 24 project) x exact-identifier, phrase, and natural-language-probe queries, plus 8 org-record-from-project-scope pairs. 224 pairs total. Seeded through the real ingest path by tests/test_memory_eval_gate.py; baseline in memory_eval_baseline.json.

records.title: billing ledger ownership (EVL_SVC_LEDGER_01)
records.body_md: The billing-ledger service owns all invoice postings and payment captures. Ledger rows are append-only; corrections are posted as reversal entries, never updates. Reference: EVL_SVC_LEDGER_01.

records.title: dark mode rollout flag (EVL_FLAG_DARKMODE_02)
records.body_md: Dark mode ships behind a percentage rollout flag managed in the flag console. The rollout holds at 25 percent until contrast audits on embedded charts pass. Reference: EVL_FLAG_DARKMODE_02.

records.title: orders table partitioning (EVL_SCHEMA_ORDERS_03)
records.body_md: The orders table is range-partitioned by month on created_at, with twelve hot partitions kept on fast storage. Older partitions are detached to the archive tablespace quarterly. Reference: EVL_SCHEMA_ORDERS_03.

records.title: edge proxy topology (EVL_TOPOLOGY_EDGE_04)
records.body_md: The edge proxy terminates public TLS and forwards to internal services over mutual TLS. Certificates rotate weekly through the internal issuer. Reference: EVL_TOPOLOGY_EDGE_04.

records.title: tenant API quotas (EVL_QUOTA_TENANT_05)
records.body_md: Each tenant gets 10000 API requests per hour enforced by a leaky-bucket counter in Redis. Burst headroom is 20 percent for five minutes before throttling returns 429. Reference: EVL_QUOTA_TENANT_05.

records.title: DNS failover design (EVL_DNS_FAILOVER_06)
records.body_md: Health-checked DNS failover flips public traffic to the warm standby stack in Frankfurt when three consecutive probes fail. TTLs are pinned to 60 seconds to bound the cutover. Reference: EVL_DNS_FAILOVER_06.

records.title: menu cache invalidation (EVL_CACHE_MENU_07)
records.body_md: Vendor menu caches are invalidated by the vendor webhook, not by TTL: a menu-changed event purges the cached menu document and repopulates it lazily on next read. Reference: EVL_CACHE_MENU_07.

records.title: enterprise SSO mapping (EVL_AUTH_SAML_08)
records.body_md: Enterprise SSO consumes a SAML assertion and maps the groups attribute onto internal roles. Unknown groups fall back to the viewer role and are logged for the identity team. Reference: EVL_AUTH_SAML_08.

records.title: export job queue (EVL_QUEUE_EXPORT_09)
records.body_md: CSV export jobs run on a dedicated low-priority queue so bulk exports can never starve interactive work. Exports above 100k rows stream directly to object storage. Reference: EVL_QUEUE_EXPORT_09.

records.title: EU data residency (EVL_GEO_SHARDING_10)
records.body_md: Customer rows for EU tenants are pinned to the Dublin cluster to satisfy residency terms. Cross-region joins are forbidden; aggregates replicate as anonymised rollups only. Reference: EVL_GEO_SHARDING_10.

records.title: mobile SDK retry policy (EVL_SDK_RETRY_11)
records.body_md: The mobile SDK retries idempotent calls with exponential backoff capped at five attempts and a 30 second ceiling. Non-idempotent calls surface the failure to the app immediately. Reference: EVL_SDK_RETRY_11.

records.title: mid-cycle proration (EVL_BILLING_PRORATE_12)
records.body_md: Mid-cycle plan upgrades are prorated per day and the unused balance is credited on the next invoice. Downgrades take effect only at the next renewal boundary. Reference: EVL_BILLING_PRORATE_12.

records.title: search synonym expansion (EVL_SEARCH_SYNONYM_13)
records.body_md: Product search expands queries through a curated synonym dictionary maintained by the catalog team. Synonym updates deploy nightly and are versioned with the index build. Reference: EVL_SEARCH_SYNONYM_13.

records.title: signed audit exports (EVL_AUDIT_EXPORT_14)
records.body_md: Audit-trail exports are signed with the org signing key so auditors can verify integrity offline with the verifier CLI. Unsigned exports are rejected by compliance tooling. Reference: EVL_AUDIT_EXPORT_14.

records.title: bounce suppression list (EVL_EMAIL_SUPPRESS_15)
records.body_md: Campaign sends consult the bounce suppression list before dispatch; hard bounces suppress an address permanently while soft bounces expire after 30 days. Reference: EVL_EMAIL_SUPPRESS_15.

records.title: invoice PDF rendering (EVL_PDF_RENDER_16)
records.body_md: Invoice PDFs render in a headless Chromium pool sized to four workers per node. Render jobs above two seconds are shed to the async path and delivered by email. Reference: EVL_PDF_RENDER_16.

records.title: checkout gateway timeout (EVL_PRJ_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_17)
records.body_md: The checkout gateway timeout was raised to 12 seconds because the payment provider's 3DS challenge flow regularly exceeds eight. The mobile client shows a progress state after four. Reference: EVL_PRJ_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT_17.

records.title: anonymous cart merge (EVL_PRJ_CART_MERGE_18)
records.body_md: Anonymous carts merge into the account cart at login: quantities take the newest value and expired promotional lines are dropped silently during the merge. Reference: EVL_PRJ_CART_MERGE_18.

records.title: tax rate caching (EVL_PRJ_TAXRATE_CACHE_19)
records.body_md: Tax-rate lookups are cached per postcode for 24 hours because the provider bills per query. Rate changes publish an invalidation message that clears affected postcodes early. Reference: EVL_PRJ_TAXRATE_CACHE_19.

records.title: product image variants (EVL_PRJ_IMG_CDN_20)
records.body_md: Product images are resized into four variants at upload and served from the CDN under immutable hashed URLs. Originals stay in cold storage for re-derivation. Reference: EVL_PRJ_IMG_CDN_20.

records.title: stock reservation window (EVL_PRJ_STOCK_RESERVE_21)
records.body_md: Stock is reserved for 15 minutes when checkout starts; the reservation sweeper releases expired holds every minute so flash-sale inventory never strands. Reference: EVL_PRJ_STOCK_RESERVE_21.

records.title: coupon stacking rules (EVL_PRJ_COUPON_STACK_22)
records.body_md: Coupon stacking is disallowed except that a free-shipping promotion may combine with one percentage discount. The rules engine evaluates stacking before totals are computed. Reference: EVL_PRJ_COUPON_STACK_22.

records.title: partner webhook signing (EVL_PRJ_WEBHOOK_SIGN_23)
records.body_md: Partner webhooks are signed with HMAC SHA-256 using a per-partner rotating secret. Receivers must verify within a five-minute timestamp window to defeat replay. Reference: EVL_PRJ_WEBHOOK_SIGN_23.

records.title: settlement reconciliation (EVL_PRJ_LEDGER_RECON_24)
records.body_md: The nightly reconciliation job compares provider settlement files against ledger captures and opens a discrepancy ticket for any mismatch above one cent. Reference: EVL_PRJ_LEDGER_RECON_24.

records.title: kafka lag incident (EVL_INC_0114_25)
records.body_md: 2026-01-14 incident: consumer lag alarms fired after a broker disk stall; partitions rebalanced for 22 minutes. Mitigation moved cold topics to tiered storage. Reference: EVL_INC_0114_25.

records.title: registry certificate expiry (EVL_INC_REGISTRY_26)
records.body_md: 2026-02-03: the internal container registry certificate expired and blocked every deploy for 47 minutes. A 30-day expiry alert and auto-renewal were added afterwards. Reference: EVL_INC_REGISTRY_26.

records.title: sprint 41 retrospective (EVL_RETRO_SPRINT41_27)
records.body_md: Sprint 41 retro concluded the Selenium suite was the top flake source; the team voted to migrate smoke coverage to Playwright and quarantine the worst specs meanwhile. Reference: EVL_RETRO_SPRINT41_27.

records.title: duplicate refund ticket (EVL_TICKET_7733_28)
records.body_md: Ticket EVL_TICKET_7733_28: double-clicking the refund button issued duplicate refunds for 19 orders. Fixed with an idempotency key derived from order and amount. Reference: EVL_TICKET_7733_28.

records.title: postgres read-only window (EVL_OUTAGE_0412_29)
records.body_md: 2026-04-12: an unattended failover triggered by a runaway vacuum froze writes for nine minutes. The autovacuum cost limit was tuned and failover now requires a health quorum. Reference: EVL_OUTAGE_0412_29.

records.title: v4.87 rollback (EVL_ROLLBACK_V487_30)
records.body_md: Release v4.87 was rolled back two hours after deploy when checkout conversion dropped six percent; the culprit was an eager address validation call blocking the pay button. Reference: EVL_ROLLBACK_V487_30.

records.title: credential stuffing spike (EVL_SPIKE_LOGIN_31)
records.body_md: A credential-stuffing spike hit login at 40x baseline; the rate limiter held and a captcha challenge was enabled for anonymous ASNs. No account takeovers were confirmed. Reference: EVL_SPIKE_LOGIN_31.

records.title: uuidv7 key migration (EVL_MIGRATE_UUIDV7_32)
records.body_md: Migrating hot tables to UUIDv7 primary keys halved index bloat and cut insert latency 30 percent because keys became time-ordered. Backfill ran online over two weekends. Reference: EVL_MIGRATE_UUIDV7_32.

records.title: region evacuation drill (EVL_DRILL_REGION_33)
records.body_md: The May region-evacuation drill met a 28-minute RTO against the 45-minute objective. DNS cutover was clean; the slow step was rehydrating the feature-flag cache. Reference: EVL_DRILL_REGION_33.

records.title: leaked API key (EVL_LEAK_APIKEY_34)
records.body_md: A contractor pasted a production API key into a public gist; the key was rotated within one hour and a repository secret scanner now runs on every push. Reference: EVL_LEAK_APIKEY_34.

records.title: dashboard N+1 fix (EVL_PERF_N1QUERY_35)
records.body_md: The activity dashboard issued an N+1 query per widget; switching to eager loading with a single join dropped page p95 by 600 milliseconds. Reference: EVL_PERF_N1QUERY_35.

records.title: pager storm postmortem (EVL_ONCALL_PAGERSTORM_36)
records.body_md: A flapping health check paged on-call 41 times in one night. A dampening window and alert dedup were added, and the check now requires three consecutive failures. Reference: EVL_ONCALL_PAGERSTORM_36.

records.title: SMS vendor outage (EVL_VENDOR_SMSOUTAGE_37)
records.body_md: During the SMS vendor outage on 2026-03-19, OTP delivery fell back to email codes automatically; login success dipped only two percent. A second SMS provider is onboarding. Reference: EVL_VENDOR_SMSOUTAGE_37.

records.title: chaos day redis kill (EVL_CHAOS_REDISKILL_38)
records.body_md: Chaos day killed the Redis primary mid-traffic; Sentinel promoted the replica in 40 seconds and rate-limit counters rebuilt from the write-behind log as designed. Reference: EVL_CHAOS_REDISKILL_38.

records.title: egress cost spike (EVL_COST_EGRESS_39)
records.body_md: The June cloud bill spiked 18 percent, traced to cross-zone egress from a replica placed in the wrong zone by the autoscaler. Placement constraints were pinned. Reference: EVL_COST_EGRESS_39.

records.title: paywall experiment result (EVL_AB_PAYWALL_40)
records.body_md: The paywall experiment concluded: variant B with the annual-first toggle raised trial conversion 14 percent and was shipped to all traffic on 2026-05-28. Reference: EVL_AB_PAYWALL_40.

records.title: beta launch numbers (EVL_PRJ_LAUNCH_BETA_41)
records.body_md: Beta launched 2026-06-02 with 400 invites; 61 percent activated within a week and the top request was CSV import of legacy catalog data. Reference: EVL_PRJ_LAUNCH_BETA_41.

records.title: cart rounding bug (EVL_PRJ_BUG_ROUNDING_42)
records.body_md: A banker's-rounding mismatch between cart and invoice undercharged baskets by one cent in three-item carts; totals now round once at the ledger boundary. Reference: EVL_PRJ_BUG_ROUNDING_42.

records.title: acme corp demo notes (EVL_PRJ_DEMO_ACME_43)
records.body_md: The Acme Corp demo went well except bulk import: they need column mapping with a preview before commit. Follow-up scheduled for the 18th with their ops lead. Reference: EVL_PRJ_DEMO_ACME_43.

records.title: checkout load test (EVL_PRJ_LOADTEST_44)
records.body_md: The pre-launch load test sustained 1200 rps at p95 under 300 ms until the worker pool saturated at the fulfillment queue; adding two workers cleared the knee. Reference: EVL_PRJ_LOADTEST_44.

records.title: DST slot hotfix (EVL_PRJ_HOTFIX_TZ_45)
records.body_md: Hotfix 2026-03-30: delivery slots displayed one hour late after the DST change because slot boundaries were computed in UTC and rendered without zone conversion. Reference: EVL_PRJ_HOTFIX_TZ_45.

records.title: security review finding (EVL_PRJ_REVIEW_SEC_46)
records.body_md: The quarterly security review flagged an unscoped S3 bucket policy on export artifacts; the policy was tightened to the exporter role and access logging enabled. Reference: EVL_PRJ_REVIEW_SEC_46.

records.title: merchant interviews (EVL_PRJ_INTERVIEW_USER_47)
records.body_md: Five merchant interviews converged on partial refunds as the top gap: support agents currently refund full orders and re-invoice manually, which breaks their books. Reference: EVL_PRJ_INTERVIEW_USER_47.

records.title: milestone M2 slip (EVL_PRJ_MILESTONE_M2_48)
records.body_md: Milestone M2 slipped one week because the payment sandbox approval from the provider took nine business days; the critical path was re-sequenced to unblock webhook work. Reference: EVL_PRJ_MILESTONE_M2_48.

records.title: postgres failover runbook (EVL_RUNBOOK_PGFAILOVER_49)
records.body_md: Failover runbook: pause writers, confirm replication lag is zero, promote the replica, repoint pgbouncer, then unpause. Never promote with lag above zero. Reference: EVL_RUNBOOK_PGFAILOVER_49.

records.title: branching policy (EVL_POLICY_BRANCH_50)
records.body_md: Trunk-based development: feature branches live at most three days, merge by squash only, and red main blocks all merges until green. Reference: EVL_POLICY_BRANCH_50.

records.title: secret rotation how-to (EVL_HOWTO_SECRETSROT_51)
records.body_md: Rotate a secret with the vault CLI: create the new version, roll consumers in a staged order, verify each consumer, then disable the old version after 24 hours. Reference: EVL_HOWTO_SECRETSROT_51.

records.title: API error standard (EVL_STD_APIERRORS_52)
records.body_md: All API errors follow RFC 9457 problem details: a registered type URL, stable title, and correlation id. Free-text error strings are forbidden in responses. Reference: EVL_STD_APIERRORS_52.

records.title: load shedding order (EVL_GUIDE_LOADSHED_53)
records.body_md: Under overload shed in this order: analytics first, then recommendations, then search suggestions. Checkout and auth are never shed; they degrade features instead. Reference: EVL_GUIDE_LOADSHED_53.

records.title: commit message convention (EVL_CONV_COMMITMSG_54)
records.body_md: Commit subjects use imperative mood with a scope prefix and stay under 72 characters; bodies explain why, not what. Fixups squash before review. Reference: EVL_CONV_COMMITMSG_54.

records.title: qdrant snapshot runbook (EVL_RUNBOOK_QDRANTSNAP_55)
records.body_md: Qdrant snapshots run nightly to object storage; the restore drill runs monthly by restoring the latest snapshot into a scratch instance and diffing collection counts. Reference: EVL_RUNBOOK_QDRANTSNAP_55.

records.title: telemetry retention policy (EVL_POLICY_DATARET_56)
records.body_md: Raw telemetry is retained 90 days then purged; hourly aggregates are kept indefinitely. Purge jobs write a ledger entry with row counts for compliance. Reference: EVL_POLICY_DATARET_56.

records.title: canary deploy how-to (EVL_HOWTO_CANARY_57)
records.body_md: Canary deploys route five percent of traffic for 30 minutes while watching the error budget burn rate; auto-rollback fires at twice the baseline burn. Reference: EVL_HOWTO_CANARY_57.

records.title: structured log fields (EVL_STD_LOGFIELDS_58)
records.body_md: Structured logs must carry trace_id, actor, and event fields; payload bodies and prompt content are forbidden in logs — metadata only, per the observability standard. Reference: EVL_STD_LOGFIELDS_58.

records.title: index review guide (EVL_GUIDE_INDEXREVIEW_59)
records.body_md: Every new database index needs an EXPLAIN ANALYZE from a production-sized dataset in the PR, plus the write-amplification estimate. Unused indexes are dropped quarterly. Reference: EVL_GUIDE_INDEXREVIEW_59.

records.title: feature flag naming (EVL_CONV_FEATUREFLAG_60)
records.body_md: Flags are named domain_action_yyyymm and must be deleted within two releases of full rollout; the flag console pages owners of expired flags weekly. Reference: EVL_CONV_FEATUREFLAG_60.

records.title: DLQ replay runbook (EVL_RUNBOOK_DLQREPLAY_61)
records.body_md: Dead-letter replay: inspect a sample, fix the root cause, then replay in batches of fifty with a pause between batches, watching the failure rate gauge. Reference: EVL_RUNBOOK_DLQREPLAY_61.

records.title: production access policy (EVL_POLICY_ACCESSREQ_62)
records.body_md: Production access requires a ticket, a named approver, and expires after eight hours; break-glass access pages the security channel and is audited next morning. Reference: EVL_POLICY_ACCESSREQ_62.

records.title: production profiling (EVL_HOWTO_PROFILING_63)
records.body_md: CPU profiling in production uses py-spy in sampling mode with 60-second captures; attach only to one worker per service and upload flamegraphs to the perf bucket. Reference: EVL_HOWTO_PROFILING_63.

records.title: migration standard (EVL_STD_MIGRATIONS_64)
records.body_md: Migrations must be reversible and lock-safe: no table rewrites in peak hours, backfills run in batches with progress checkpoints, and every migration ships its down path. Reference: EVL_STD_MIGRATIONS_64.

records.title: manual refund runbook (EVL_PRJ_RUNBOOK_REFUND_65)
records.body_md: Manual refund: verify the settlement landed, issue the refund from the provider console, then post the ledger note with the ticket reference before closing. Reference: EVL_PRJ_RUNBOOK_REFUND_65.

records.title: go-live checklist (EVL_PRJ_CHECKLIST_GOLIVE_66)
records.body_md: Go-live checklist: DNS cutover window agreed, cache warmed from the staging snapshot, rollback rehearsed end-to-end, and the on-call rota doubled for launch week. Reference: EVL_PRJ_CHECKLIST_GOLIVE_66.

records.title: pricing change process (EVL_PRJ_STD_PRICING_67)
records.body_md: Pricing changes require finance sign-off and 30 days notice to affected merchants; grandfathered plans are flagged in the catalog and excluded from repricing jobs. Reference: EVL_PRJ_STD_PRICING_67.

records.title: payment sandbox reset (EVL_PRJ_HOWTO_SANDBOX_68)
records.body_md: Reset the payment sandbox by clearing registered webhooks, reseeding the test card set, and re-running the smoke checkout; document the sandbox version in the run log. Reference: EVL_PRJ_HOWTO_SANDBOX_68.

records.title: sev1 support policy (EVL_PRJ_POLICY_SUPPORT_69)
records.body_md: Sev1 merchant issues: respond within 15 minutes, page the merchant-success lead, and open a status-page incident if more than five merchants are affected. Reference: EVL_PRJ_POLICY_SUPPORT_69.

records.title: catalog bulk updates (EVL_PRJ_GUIDE_CATALOG_70)
records.body_md: Catalog bulk updates go through CSV upload with a dry-run diff preview; apply only after the diff is approved, and keep the rejected-rows file for the merchant. Reference: EVL_PRJ_GUIDE_CATALOG_70.

records.title: stuck order recovery (EVL_PRJ_RUNBOOK_STUCKORD_71)
records.body_md: Stuck order recovery: requeue the fulfillment event with a fresh idempotency key, confirm the state machine advances, then notify the customer with the revised ETA. Reference: EVL_PRJ_RUNBOOK_STUCKORD_71.

records.title: analytics event naming (EVL_PRJ_CONV_EVENTNAME_72)
records.body_md: Analytics events are snake_case verb_noun, registered in the schema registry before first emit; unregistered events are dropped at the collector with a weekly report. Reference: EVL_PRJ_CONV_EVENTNAME_72.
